title: fix: do not cache chat streams that carry no output
author: Drjacky

gist.summary: Chat Completions streams with no user-facing output are no longer written to the text cache. Identical requests can reach a model again instead of replaying a cached empty answer; clients still receive the original stream unchanged. Role-only and reasoning-only deltas, finish reasons, and usage chunks do not count as output, while text, tool calls, function calls, audio, and refusals do. Existing stream cache entries are retired with a cache-version change. Non-streaming responses and other SSE streams retain their previous caching behavior.
